sample_dialogue: вот такая хуйня собачка, вот такая соба хуйнячка, вот такачка соба хуйня, такава тачка, соба хуйня
performance_prompt: Native Russian male, around 50. Low, dry, ordinary speaking voice. Speak quietly and calmly, almost monotone, as if casually talking to one person at a kitchen table. Keep pitch nearly level from start to finish; use only very small natural intonation changes. Speak slightly brisker than normal conversational speed, approximately 10% faster, with compact connected words, short vowels, and very brief pauses between fragments. Pronounce each nonsensical fragment exactly as written without adding or correcting words. No acting, storytelling performance, stage diction, dramatic emphasis, emotional color, irony, punchline signaling, smiling voice, or rhetorical rise. Do not whisper, sound sleepy, rush, or stretch syllables. Plain, restrained, matter-of-fact speech.
user_comment: Настройки 045 перенесены на новую фразу; запрошено небольшое ускорение примерно на 10 процентов. Flow не соблюдает процент математически, оценивать результат следует на слух.
